nodes.label: KosRank
nodes.rationale: Modern SAW-based kos recommendation web app (Next.js 15 + PostgreSQL); reimagines the PHP study systems with scalable clean architecture, production readiness, and a modern minimalist UI.

nodes.label: KosRank SAW Implementation
nodes.rationale: Ports the SAW pipeline (Input Data -> Convert To Score -> Decision Matrix -> Normalization -> Weighted Calculation -> Final Score -> Ranking) into the src/features/saw module of the Next.js app.

nodes.label: Simple Additive Weighting (SAW) Method
nodes.rationale: Metode penjumlahan terbobot: rank alternatives by summing weight x normalized rating over all attributes after decision-matrix normalization (X); chosen across the literature for simplicity, speed, and objective ranking with total weight sum = 1.

nodes.label: UML (Use Case, Activity, Class, Sequence Diagrams)
nodes.norm_label: uml (use case, activity, class, sequence diagrams)

nodes.label: Skala Likert 1-5 (Bobot Kepentingan)
nodes.rationale: Sangat penting=5 down to Sangat tidak penting=1; values divided by 100 (yielding 0.01-0.05) to become SAW weights.

nodes.label: Baseline Criteria & Weights C1-C5
nodes.rationale: Weights sum to 1.0: Harga 0.3 (Cost), Luas Kamar 0.1, Fasilitas Kamar 0.2, Fasilitas Umum 0.2 (Benefit), Jarak 0.2 (Cost); price and distance are Cost attributes because lower values are better for students.

nodes.label: SAW Normalization Rij (Benefit/Cost)
nodes.rationale: Benefit: Rij = Xij / Max(Xij); Cost: Rij = Min(Xij) / Xij - puts heterogeneous criteria (rupiah, km, facility counts) on one comparable scale.

nodes.label: SAW Ranking Vi = sum(Wj * Rij)
nodes.rationale: Multiply normalized matrix by weights and sum per alternative; sort descending - highest Vi is the best recommendation.

nodes.label: SAW Implementation Steps (Rating -> Normalization -> Ranking)
nodes.rationale: Four-step recipe: define criteria/weights, map raw inputs to suitability scores via sub-kriteria, normalize the matrix per attribute type (Benefit vs Cost), then rank by Vi = sum(Wj * Rij) descending; highest score wins.

nodes.label: KosRank Criteria C1-C5 (SAW Weights)
nodes.rationale: Same weighting scheme as the INFOS study: Harga 0.3 Cost; Luas Kamar 0.1, Fasilitas Kamar 0.2, Fasilitas Umum 0.2 (Benefit); Jarak 0.2 Cost.

nodes.label: Criteria C1-C6 (Depok, 6 Kriteria)
nodes.rationale: Extends the Condong Catur baseline with Ukuran Ruangan and Akses Transportasi for UBSI Margonda/Depok: Harga 0.3 and Jarak 0.2 are Cost; Ukuran Ruangan 0.15, Fasilitas Kamar 0.15, Fasilitas Kos 0.1, Akses Transportasi 0.1 are Benefit.

nodes.rationale: Signature orange is reserved for add-to-cart/deals; it is banned for text because it fails accessibility contrast on white - #007185 teal is the established interactive text/link color.

nodes.label: Information Density Principle
nodes.rationale: Users scan rather than browse: price carries the largest visual weight, social proof (ratings, badges) sits near titles, Add to Cart must be visible without scrolling, and no pixel is spent on decorative whitespace.
